items.headline: Council to study banning pesticides on city property
items.summary: A special study session is scheduled to consider eliminating the use of chemical pesticides on property owned or leased by the City of Sunnyvale.

items.headline: Cupertino faces multiple lawsuits, council to discuss in closed session
items.summary: The council is scheduled to discuss three active lawsuits against the city in closed session: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino, Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino, and Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety v. City of Cupertino, all filed in Santa Clara County Superior Court.

items.headline: Sustainability Commission to hear about data center impacts
items.summary: The Sustainability Commission meeting includes a presentation on the environmental impacts of data centers.
